metrics.name: Total Assets Under Management (AUM)
metrics.description: Total disbursed amount of all currently active and non-performing loans across every product.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE loan_status IN ('active','npa')
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE loan_status IN ('active','npa') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Active Loan Count
metrics.description: Number of live loans on the book (active plus non-performing).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE loan_status IN ('active','npa')
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE loan_status IN ('active','npa') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Active Borrowers
metrics.description: Distinct borrowers with at least one live loan.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT borrower_id) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE loan_status IN ('active','npa')
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT borrower_id) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE loan_status IN ('active','npa') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Ticket Size
metrics.description: Average disbursed amount per loan across the book.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, AVG(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Interest Rate (Yield)
metrics.description: Average annual interest rate across the loan book — the portfolio yield proxy.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(interest_rate) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE interest_rate > 0
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, AVG(interest_rate) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE interest_rate > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Gross NPA (GNPA %)
metrics.description: Share of live loans in IndAS Stage 3 (90+ DPD). The headline asset-quality metric.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 3) / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE loan_status IN ('active','npa')) AS value FROM loans_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 3) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE loan_status IN ('active','npa')), 0) AS value FROM loans_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Stage 3 (NPA) Loans
metrics.description: Count of non-performing loans (90+ DPD, IndAS Stage 3).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE stage = 3
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE stage = 3 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Total Overdue Value
metrics.description: Sum of overdue amounts across delinquent live loans.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(overdue_amount) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE loan_status IN ('active','npa')
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, SUM(overdue_amount) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE loan_status IN ('active','npa') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Write-off Rate
metrics.description: Share of all loans that have been written off as irrecoverable.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE loan_status = 'written_off') / COUNT(*) AS value FROM loans_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE loan_status = 'written_off') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM loans_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Monthly Disbursement
metrics.description: Total amount disbursed in the most recent month.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) = (SELECT MAX(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date)) FROM loans_full)
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Application Approval Rate
metrics.description: Share of loan applications that were approved and disbursed.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'disbursed') / COUNT(*) AS value FROM applications_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', apply_date) AS DATE) AS date, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'disbursed') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM applications_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Collection Efficiency
metrics.description: Amount collected as a share of amount due across the EMI ledger.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(amount_paid) / SUM(amount_due) AS value FROM collections_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', due_date) AS DATE) AS date, 100.0 * SUM(amount_paid) / NULLIF(SUM(amount_due), 0) AS value FROM collections_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: EMI Bounce Rate
metrics.description: Share of EMI presentations that bounced on first attempt.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bounce = true) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM collections_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', due_date) AS DATE) AS date, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bounce = true) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM collections_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Collection Resolution Rate
metrics.description: Share of collection actions that ended in a resolved case.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'resolved') / COUNT(*) AS value FROM collections_actions_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', action_date) AS DATE) AS date, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'resolved') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM collections_actions_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Cross-sell Conversion Rate
metrics.description: Share of pre-approved personal-loan offers that resulted in a disbursed loan.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'disbursed') / COUNT(*) AS value FROM crosssell_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', offer_date) AS DATE) AS date, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'disbursed') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM crosssell_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Cross-sell Disbursed Value
metrics.description: Total pre-approved amount disbursed through the personal-loan cross-sell funnel.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(pre_approved_amount) AS value FROM crosssell_full WHERE status = 'disbursed'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', offer_date) AS DATE) AS date, SUM(pre_approved_amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'disbursed') AS value FROM crosssell_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Bureau Score
metrics.description: Average credit bureau score of credit-tested borrowers (excludes New-to-Credit at 0).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(bureau_score) AS value FROM borrowers_full WHERE bureau_score > 0
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_date) AS DATE) AS date, AVG(bureau_score) AS value FROM borrowers_full WHERE bureau_score > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: New-to-Credit Share
metrics.description: Share of borrowers with no prior bureau history (NTC).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_ntc = true) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM borrowers_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_date) AS DATE) AS date, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_ntc = true) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM borrowers_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Repeat Borrower Share
metrics.description: Share of borrowers on their second or third loan with Suvidha.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_repeat_borrower = true) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM borrowers_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_date) AS DATE) AS date, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_repeat_borrower = true) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value FROM borrowers_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date
